items.title: Distribution Officer/Executive

items.experience: At least 1 year; FMCG/manufacturing experience required

items.title: Executive, IPE

Exact IPE degree match, but the 2–4 year experience requirement is above your current tenure; treat as a stretch application. Client identity is confidential until shortlisting.
items.status: Verified listing – stretch experience requirement; deadline tomorrow

items.title: Trainee Officer / Officer – Procurement

Fresh graduates are encouraged for Trainee Officer; 1–3 years preferred for Officer. Manufacturing/FMCG experience is an advantage. IPE is not explicitly named in the qualification list, so confirm eligibility with HR.
items.status: Verified listing – fresh graduates encouraged for Trainee Officer; confirm IPE eligibility
